All 18 playbook rules have been reviewed and submitted. Summary:

**Deviations / missing (redlined):**
- **LOL-CAP** — Section 7 excludes indirect damages but has no aggregate cap at all; added a mutual cap (greater of 12 months' amounts paid/payable or USD 1M) with standard uncapped carve-outs.
- **LICENSE** — Platform licence is revocable at Kubient's discretion and excludes affiliates/contractors/successors; deleted "revocable" and extended the grant.
- **RENEWAL** — Auto 1-year renewals exitable only on 90 days' notice; shortened Customer's notice to 30 days (Kubient's left at 90).
- **INSURANCE** (missing) — No insurance clause for a vendor storing visitor data; inserted standard CGL/E&O/cyber paragraph.
- **TRANSITION** (missing) — No exit assistance or data return; inserted transition assistance, 30-day machine-readable data return and certified deletion.

**Compliant:** INDEMN (preferred), NONCOMPETE, EXCLUSIVITY, MFN, NOSOLICIT, T4C (fallback, 90 days), GOVLAW (Delaware law/NY courts — fallback; noted Section 8 arbitration conflict), ASSIGN, IP (noted no express Customer Data ownership line), AUDIT, LD, WARRANTY (noted no express repair/replace/refund remedy), MINCOMMIT.
